raw_excerpt: w3c/CSSWG Scroll-driven Animations spec. Drafts.csswg.org/scroll-animations-1. The specification that defines scroll-timeline and view-timeline properties. Reference for the canonical implementation of scroll-driven animations. Independent cross-references: scroll-timeline-axis (block | inline | x | y), scroll-timeline-name (--custom-ident), view-timeline-inset (percentage), animation-range-start, animation-range-end. Confirms the MDN and Chrome DevRel claims as authoritative.
